working_definition: Adult VNC cells the authors predict to be hemilineage 8A or 24B, not separated (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2).
justification: 8A is a Notch ON and 24B a Notch OFF hemilineage: their only common parent is adult (secondary) neuron, which is not adequate. Held (curator 2026-10-18).
